biography: Karim Sekkat, born in Marrakech, Morocco, discovered his passion for racing not on a track, but navigating the bustling city streets on his battered scooter. The agility and precision required to weave through traffic ignited a competitive fire within him. He started karting relatively late, at 16, but his raw talent was immediately apparent. A local businessman, impressed by Karim's fearless driving during a regional karting championship, sponsored his entry into the Ginetta racing scene. His early years were marked by spectacular highs and equally dramatic lows – a testament to his inconsistent nature. While he showed flashes of brilliance, like his dominant performance at Silverstone in 2021, consistency proved to be his Achilles' heel. Now at 28, considered to be in his peak years, Karim is striving to temper his aggressive instincts and convert potential into consistent podium finishes. He hopes to use his Ginetta platform as a stepping stone to a higher category.
drivingStyle: Karim's driving style is a high-risk, high-reward approach. He's known for his late-braking maneuvers and aggressive corner entries, often pushing the car to its absolute limit. While this occasionally results in breathtaking overtakes, it also leads to costly errors and tire degradation. Tire management is an area Karim struggles with, often burning through his rubber in the early stages of a race. Under pressure, he can either elevate his game to another level or crack completely, making him an unpredictable opponent.

rivalries.name: Alessandro Rossi
rivalries.reason: A clash on the final lap at Brands Hatch in 2022 resulted in both drivers retiring, sparking a bitter feud that continues to this day.

rivalries.name: Isabelle Dubois
rivalries.reason: A difference in racing philosophy. Isabelle believes in consistent and calculated racing, while Karim favors a more aggressive and unpredictable style, leading to frequent on-track battles and off-track disagreements.

rivalries.name: Kenji Tanaka
rivalries.reason: Both drivers came up through the karting ranks together, and their rivalry has always been intense, fueled by a mutual respect and a desire to prove who is the superior driver.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky blue wristband given to him by his grandmother.
Listens to traditional Gnawa music to calm his nerves before each race.
Refuses to eat anything red on race day, believing it brings bad luck.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't about playing it safe; it's about taking risks and pushing boundaries. You only truly live when you're on the edge."
careerHighlight: Winning the Ginetta GT4 Supercup race at Silverstone in 2021 after starting from 10th on the grid, showcasing his incredible overtaking ability and determination.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out on the first lap of the 24 Hours of Spa in 2022 due to over-aggression, costing his team a potential podium finish and severely damaging the car.
